text:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a small PLG experiment called "Funnel Symphony": a 20-min micro-webinar + credit hooks + starter prompt bundle. Goal: lift Day-3 activation by ~+15%. Thoughts?

amir: Love the name. What's the minimal set of variants we can run without exploding our sample?

maya: Two axes we care about: credit amount (20 vs 50) and timing of the webinar invite (immediate vs 48h drip). Also a prompt-pack add-on (yes/no). Full factorial is 8 cells; propose a prioritized 4-arm fold to keep power reasonable.

sophia: Can we route high-intent inbound (api key created + first call within 24h) to an immediate live webinar seat? That cohort should have higher lift — push them into the higher-credit variant.

leo: Agree. Metric guardrails: primary = day3_activation_rate, secondary = cost_per_activation and webinar_attendance. Target CPA <$40.

growth-bot: Recommendation: cohort bucketing by first-3-calls + org domain. Also try personalized invite lines using first-product-action in the CTA. Small personalization often moves attendance.

maya: Draft experiment config below — lightweight YAML-ish snippet for ops: 
```
cohort_def: new_signup && created_at < 72h
variants:
 - V1: credit=20, invite=immediate, prompt_pack=false
 - V2: credit=50, invite=immediate, prompt_pack=true
 - V3: credit=20, invite=48h, prompt_pack=true
 - V4: control
sample_size: 4000_total, min_per_variant: 800
primary_metric: day3_activation_rate
secondary: cost_per_activation, webinar_attendance
```

sophia: Nice. Quick Q on attribution: can we add unique join codes per cohort so attendance maps back to variant? marketing-bot: yes, we can generate promo codes and a UTM per variant, then attribute via registration API.

amir: I'll own routing rules and the signup->webinar Zap. Will need the UTM mapping and the live webinar calendar slots.

maya: I'll draft 3 invite copy variants (direct, benefit-led, social-proof) and the prompt-pack content (5 starter templates) by EOD.

leo: Engineering can add a microflow to surface the prompt pack after first successful query — small modal with "Try these prompts" and a CTA to apply one. ETA ~5 days.

sophia: Also propose a tiny A/B inside the experiment on CTA wording in the invite: "Get 50 free credits" vs "Join a live workshop + credits" — could change attendance.

maya: Action items: maya = invite copy + prompt pack; amir = routing + zap + UTM mapping; leo = microflow for in-product prompt surfacing; growth-bot = sample/power calc and cohort bucketing logic; marketing-bot = promo codes & UTMs. Check-in Friday 11am PST. :rocket: :thumbsup:

amir: Sounds good — assigning tasks in Asana now. :white_check_mark:

leo: Will mock the modal in Figma and share link here when ready. :raised_hands:

marketing-bot: Promo codes queued — will publish when cohorts are live.

maya: Thanks team — excited to run this.
